deviations_from_prereg: [phenology model] G2F predicted-maturity and BRIWECS predicted-heading ridge models keep the round-1 grid (10^-2..10^5; v7 grid applies to yield models); their lambda is chosen once per outer fold with the P1 validation fold and held fixed across P1/P2/P3.

[inner folds] P1/P3 inner folds reuse the outer-fold feature construction (SNP standardisation, PC/EC z-scores, predicted phenology, EC anchors) and fit a centred ridge on the inner-training rows (outer Gram minus held-out rows, re-centred). Round 5 rebuilt the design per inner fold. No test-env data enters; inner-validation genotypes and phenology (not yield) enter the feature statistics.
[P1 = one P3 fold] The P1 validation fold is one of the P3 inner folds (S1/S3 nearest training year, tie -> earlier; S2 fold (k+1) mod 5); the P1 fold also tunes the C2 GxE model (as R5).

[BRIWECS records] S3 uses yield + genotyped (135K, 221 cultivars) records, envs >= 30 cultivars (98 envs, 2015-2020); observed heading is not required (round 3 required it: 77 envs). Round-3 records are used only for the baseline check.
[BRIWECS CERIS] 7 DWD daily variables common to all six sites + VPD (Tetens). Env = location x year x treatment; weather (and hence the index) is shared by treatments of a location-year.

[G2F CERIS] Variables/windows as v5 (days after env median planting, d1 0..140); candidates whose window exceeds an env's weather record are NaN and ignored by the argmax (as R5). Nested search uses all training envs with records; leaky adds the included test envs (as R5).
[S2 locations] Location list = sorted unique locations among envs with modelling records (yield + genotyped + weather); equality with the trait-file location list is reported.
[C2 GxE features] PC x index and index main effect z-scored on outer-training records and reused for the P1 inner fold.
[Holm] Holm adjustment applied to one-sided env-bootstrap p-values ((1 + #bootstrap means <= 0)/(B + 1)); the prereg does not specify how p is obtained. Decisions use the unadjusted CI.

[common-population baseline] Hybrid names for the common population come from lima_meta.json copied from the R6 workspace (sha256 e811c8f5...); maturity model trained on common hybrids only and PCs from all 5,899 VCF hybrids, as in R6; the v5 code path (not the R6 engine) is used. [BRIWECS baseline] Round-3 forward check uses round-3 records, round-3 penalty grid and the round-3 M0plus lambda (as v5).
[overall_verdict] Mapping declared: C_CONFIRMED_STRONG -> GO, C_PARTIAL -> WEAK_GO, C_NOT_CONFIRMED -> NO_GO.

[memory] Peak RSS of the first G2F run was not captured (macOS /usr/bin/time -l could not read sysctl in the sandbox); the reproducibility rerun measured 4.07 GB (G2F) and 3.10 GB (BRIWECS; first run 3.08 GB), both below the 5 GB limit.
structured_output.one_paragraph_summary_zh: 按 prereg v7（sha256 18406b3c…）执行 H1/H2。基线先复现：G2F 前向 M0plus 全体 0.190269（目标 0.1903）、共同群体 0.189239（目标 0.18924），BRIWECS 第 3 轮 0.612529（目标 0.6125）。H1 在 3/3 个设置满足规则，判定 CONFIRMED：CERIS 式窗口搜索看过测试环境后，折外环境均值 r 的乐观偏差为 S1 0.126611 [0.073793, 0.179119]、S2 0.088493 [0.037793, 0.13918]、S3 0.239235 [0.046331, 0.437243]；C2 G×E 模型的环境内 r 几乎不受影响（泄漏−嵌套 -0.001209、0.000525、0.00143）。H2 在 0/3 个设置满足规则，判定 NOT_CONFIRMED：D = ΔEC(P1) − ΔEC(P2) 为 S1 -8.4e-05 [-0.011314, 0.010906]、S2 -0.007365 [-0.012788, -0.002249]（仅此 1 个设置显著为负，未达“反方向”所需的 2 个）、S3 -0.000631 [-0.002167, 0.000859]。三种协议下 ΔEC 全为负，推荐的 P3 估计为 S1 -0.015297、S2 -0.022658、S3 -0.002221，即 EC 交互项在环境内排名上不优于仅 SNP 模型。S1 中单年调参（P1）相对测试集择优损失 M_G 0.035229、M0plus 0.035313，两者相当，因此相减后抵消。论文层面决策 C_PARTIAL，overall_verdict WEAK_GO：C 方向论文应以已确证的 H1 为主，H2 作为未复现结果报告。两次独立运行结果逐位一致（最大差 0.0）；重跑峰值内存 G2F 4.07 GB、BRIWECS 3.1 GB。
